title: Object Storage: usage unit
content:
Object Storage usage unit is defined as follows: Primary meter quantity unit; string.

| Contract tier | Usage unit |
| --- | --- |
| Northbridge Object Storage 5 TB | usage unit: GB-month |
| Northbridge Object Storage 10 TB | usage unit: GB-month |
| Northbridge Object Storage 25 TB | usage unit: GB-month |
| Northbridge Object Storage 50 TB | usage unit: GB-month |
| Northbridge Object Storage 100 TB | usage unit: GB-month |
| Northbridge Object Storage 250 TB | usage unit: GB-month |

## Tier reference

For Northbridge Object Storage 5 TB, the usage unit entry is GB-month.
